title: Cosmic Paw and Snow Globe
description: A surreal black and white illustration on a vibrant red background features a large multi-eyed spherical creature with a smiling face floating above a snow globe containing a hiker in a mountainous lavender field. To the right, a massive glossy black paw print with geometric patterns and starry accents dominates the rocky foreground.
prompt: Surreal black and white illustration with vibrant red background, a large spherical white creature with multiple purple eyes and a smiling face floats above a detailed snow globe showing a backpacker hiking through a lavender flower field with mountains, beside it a massive glossy black paw print covered in white geometric star patterns and constellation lines, floating black orbs with similar markings, rocky white ground, cosmic ethereal atmosphere, intricate linework
